```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 2500)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               ggpubr,
               ggeffects,
               Hmisc,
               car,
               psych,
               data.table,
               lme4,
               lsmeans,
               sjPlot,
               afex,
               rstatix,
               emmeans,
               multcomp,
               lsmeans,
               ggdark,
               effectsize)

# Fill in your own wd here
setwd("")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in and set up data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Useful to have a long and a wide version for different tables and visualizations -- results should be the same across both! For the long df, each row is unique at the participant-transmission risk unit.
load("./perceiver risk x harm cleaned and recoded.rda")
load("./perceiver risk x harm cleaned and recoded WIDE.rda")

# Filter out responses that meet the criteria outlined in the pre-registration
cleaned_long %<>% filter(problem == 0)
cleaned %<>% filter(problem == 0)
```

## Descriptive statistics and plots

```{r descriptives}
# now split by condition
describeBy(dplyr::select(cleaned, hightrans_concealmentdv, medtrans_concealmentdv,
                  lowtrans_concealmentdv), group = cleaned$condition)

# Just trans risk
describe(dplyr::select(cleaned, hightrans_concealmentdv, medtrans_concealmentdv,
                  lowtrans_concealmentdv))

# Just symptom severity
describeBy(cleaned_long$values, group = cleaned_long$condition)
```

```{r plots}
# For manuscript
ggplot(cleaned_long, aes(x = condition, y = values, fill = trans_risk_fct)) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", alpha = .7, position = "dodge") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = .1,
               position = position_dodge(width = .9), color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = trans_risk_fct), position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = .9),
             alpha = .5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Concealment frequency by transmission risk and symptom severity", y = "Likelihood of concealment", x = "Symptom Severity",
       fill = "Transmission Risk") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("None", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe")) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#6699CC", "#332288")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#88CCEE", "#6699CC", "#332288")) +
  theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))
```

## Linear mixed model
```{r lmer ANOVA}
# run model
harmxrisk_lmer <- lmer(values ~ trans_risk_fct * condition + (1|ResponseId), REML = TRUE,
                       data = cleaned_long)

# compute ANOVA table
harmxrisk_anova <- anova(harmxrisk_lmer, type = "III", test.statistics = "F")

harmxrisk_anova
cohens_f(harmxrisk_anova, alternative = "two.sided")

# Tranmission risk pairwise comparisons (main effect)
emm_transrisk <- emmeans(harmxrisk_lmer, specs = pairwise ~ trans_risk_fct)

emm_transrisk

# Effect size
eff_size(emm_transrisk, sigma = sigma(harmxrisk_lmer), edf = Inf)

# Symptom severity pairwise comparisons (main effect)
emm_symptomseverity <- emmeans(harmxrisk_lmer, specs = pairwise ~ condition)

emm_symptomseverity

# Effect size
eff_size(emm_symptomseverity, sigma = sigma(harmxrisk_lmer), edf = Inf)
```
